title: Titan's Mysteries Revealed by NASA's Cassini

scenes.text: NASA's Cassini mission discovers liquid methane lakes on Titan
Titan's surface temperature is around -179°C, making it one of the coldest places in the solar system
scenes.label: COLDEST PLACE

scenes.text: Cassini has observed geysers of water vapor and organic compounds erupting from Titan's surface
scenes.label: GEYSERS

scenes.text: Titan's atmosphere is composed mostly of nitrogen and methane, with a pressure 45% greater than Earth's
scenes.label: ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.
